name: Claude 书卷
description: 橘棕衬线书卷风，借鉴 github.com/GordenSun/WX 的 Claude 主题。主色 #C96442 呼应 Claude CLI 色带，配暖米底 #FAF9F6 + 墨棕正文 #3D2E20 + Songti SC 衬线，适合深度文/读书笔记/方法拆解。H1 下划居中、H2 左竖条、blockquote 左条柔底、pre 暖纸本、hr 菱形装饰。

styles.container: background-color: #FAF9F6; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC',serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #C96442; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #C96442; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC',serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #3D2E20; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 4px solid #3D2E20; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC',serif;
styles.h3: font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #C96442; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #C96442; font-family: 'PingFang SC','Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC',serif;
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #3D2E20; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid #C96442;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B5D4F; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #9C8E7F; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #3D2E20; line-height: 1.85; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #C96442; background: #FAF3EB; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 15px; color: #6B5D4F; line-height: 1.75;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #6B5D4F; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; background: transparent;
styles.a: color: #C96442; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed #C96442; padding-bottom: 1px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; display: block; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: #FAF9F6;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; border: none; text-align: center; color: #C96442; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 8px; content: ◆ ◆ ◆;
styles.code: background: #F5E3D7; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 92%; color: #C96442; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FAF7F0; border: 1px solid #EAE3D4; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #3D2E20; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #F5E3D7; color: #6B5D4F; font-size: 12px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #3D2E20; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #C96442; background: #FAF3EB; border-bottom: 1px solid #EAE3D4;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #3D2E20; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #9C8E7F; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
